mentions.note: died 10 January 1973 aged 66; joined 4 March 1937; 5th Barking to Southend Police Championship 1938 in 5:38:02; in winning team R.W.A. National Junior 10 miles 1939; Walking Secretary after the war to 1952; Club Treasurer 1952-62; Club President 1957/58; first R.W.A. National Coaching Secretary 1963/64

share.d: S. C. (Syd) Roberts in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1973: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
